title: Website development in Kingman, AZ | Creosote Labs
meta_description: Creosote Labs builds websites, booking and quote tools, and web applications for Kingman, Arizona businesses. Fixed price, hosting and domain included.
h1: Website and web application development in Kingman
intro: Kingman businesses serve local customers in Mohave County as well as travelers passing through on I-40 and Route 66. Motels, restaurants, tour companies, auto repair shops, and contractors often rely on a Google Business Profile, a Facebook page, and a website that was last updated years ago, with bookings and quote requests handled by phone. Website and web application work applies wherever a customer needs to find the business, understand what it offers, and take the next step online.

Creosote Labs builds marketing websites with clear services, pricing, and a way to book or contact the business, and customer-facing tools such as quote request forms, online bookings, intake forms, and portals. For businesses with a manual process behind the counter, we build web applications that staff and customers use directly. Hosting setup, domain configuration, and handover documentation are included. Projects are quoted after a scoping call at a fixed price, with no hourly billing, and can be delivered remotely or with visits to Kingman.
projects: A booking page for a Kingman motel that shows live availability and takes reservations without a third-party commission.
A quote request form for a roofing company that collects the address, roof type, and photos and creates a lead in the office system.
A menu and online ordering site for a Route 66 restaurant, with the menu managed from a single file the owner edits.
A tenant portal for a property management company where residents submit maintenance requests and view their ledger.
An intake form for a chiropractic office that collects history and insurance details before the first visit.
A service scheduling tool for an auto repair shop that replaces phone tag with a confirmed appointment.

faqs.q: How is a website project priced?
faqs.a: After a 20-minute scoping call, we send a fixed quote for the full project. There is no hourly billing, and hosting setup and domain configuration are part of the price.

faqs.q: What does the business need to provide?
faqs.a: The business provides its logo, current photos, a list of services with prices where they exist, and access to the domain registrar. Where copy or photos are missing, that is noted in the scope.

faqs.q: Who owns and updates the site afterward?
faqs.a: The business does. The site is delivered with documentation and a handover session, and the hosting and domain configuration are handed over with it.
